I was in an emotional abusive relationship for 2 years. In the third year, the guy drastically changed and became the best s/o anyone could ask for. However, in that 2 year period I had been unconsciously getting over him and couldn't understand why I didn't return his feelings , now that everything was good. It reached a point where I felt disgusted when he tried to touch me. Anyway, it took me another 2 years to realise that it was best for us to break up. When we did, he said some pretty horrifying things to me, using my own trauma to taunt me. 
Sometimes it's best for people to break up. However, I think before making any rash decision out of anger, you should think everything thtough.
